text:
marco: Heads-up — proposing a gated rollout for KV cache ownership migration. goal: migrate ownership for shards without impacting tail latency or causing prefix duplication. TL;DR: per-shard, automated gates, quick rollback on signal spikes.

ashley: +1. main worry is bursty handoffs during traffic spikes. do we need a synthetic spike test per shard before cutover?

tina: add lease_conflict_rate and eviction_requeue_count to gates. if those go up, we should stop the rollout immediately.

marco: proposed gate checks: 1) handoff_latency_p50 < 30ms; 2) eviction_reject_rate < 0.2%; 3) lease_conflict_rate < 0.1/min per shard; require a 10m steady window. also verify no duplicate primary claims for same prefix.

rachel: ops-bot should do a staged migrate: migrate one shard, wait verification window, then continue. canary size increments at 1,2,4,8 shards with backoff.

ops-bot: command sketch: `/migrate-kv --shard $SHARD --mode gated --health handoff_latency,eviction_rejects,lease_conflicts --window 10m`

ashley: preflight checklist: prefill cache for target shard, run read-after-write smoke, verify prefix-pin metrics (pins_dropped == 0), and run a single benign write to ensure residency moves cleanly.

tina: invariant to assert in monitor: for any prefix P, count(ownership_claims{prefix=P}[1m]) == 1. If >1 then alert Sev2. PromQL we can use as a quick check: `sum_over_time(ownership_claims{prefix="$P"}[1m])` and compare with expected.

marco: rollout policy detail: start with shard=1, wait 10m stable, then double shards on stable windows. circuit breaker: if ANY gate trips -> abort, rollback last batch. rollback is idempotent: take shard back to previous owner and rehydrate cache on previous owner.

rachel: add observability surfaces post-migrate: `handoff_durations_histogram`, `eviction_requeue_count`, `prefix_staleness_count`, and expose shard-level telemetry in Console for the canary.

ashley: I'll own the rollback playbook draft: commands for emergency revert, verify, and contact list. will include quick grep-able queries and the exact ops-bot commands.

marco: action items: ashley -> runbook + rollback commands; tina -> add & tag metrics in prometheus; ops-bot -> implement gated migration script with the health checks; rachel -> dashboard tile + ephemeral alerts for canary window.

rachel: scheduled tentative canary Thu 10:00 UTC. I'll create the dashboard and the ephemeral alert rule scoped to the canary shards. :eyes:

marco: nice. if anything odd, ping me and @ashley. I'll post a short postmortem-style thread here after the canary with timings and any corrective work.

ashley: quick note — make sure we run the prefill with the same tenant affinity to avoid hotkey surprises. also add a scorecard so SLO owners can opt-out individual tenants if they see regressions.

marco: agreed. one more safety: require a passing dry-run run in staging that simulates takeover + quick rollback, and require that dry-run artifacts (logs, trace IDs) are stored in the canary folder for later audit.

ops-bot: ack — will surface logs under `s3://redwood-canaries/kv-migration/1737129000/` by default and emit a `migration_event` trace to X-trace.

marco: OK team — thanks. let's reconvene after the run and keep this thread for notes + followups.
